p: he walked in the ways of: He was an idolater like them.
Baalim: As the idolaters have certain chief idols, who are as patrons (as were these Baalim) so have they others who are inferior and represent the great idols.
Pekah the son of Remaliah slew: Who was king of Israel.
two hundred thousand: Thus by the just judgment of God, Israel destroyed Judah.
because the LORD God of your: For they thought they had overcome them by their own valiantness, and did not consider that God had delivered them into their hands, because Judah had offended him.
sins against the LORD your God: May not God also punish you for your sins as he has done these men for theirs, seeing that yours are greater?
Ephraim: Which tribe was now greatest and had most authority.
offended against the LORD already: God will not allow this sin which we commit against him, to go unpunished.
expressed by name rose up: Whose name were rehearsed before, 2Ch 28:12.
anointed them: Either for their wounds or weariness.
brethren: To them of the tribe of Judah.
kings of Assyria to help him: To Tiglath Pileser and those kings who were under his dominion, 2Ki 16:7.
Israel: He means Judah, because Ahaz forsook the Lord and sought help from the infidels. See Geneva
2Ch 15:17 for when Judah was called Israel.
smote him: As he falsely supposed.

help me: Thus the wicked measure God's favour by prosperity and adversity: for if idolaters prosper, they make their idols gods, not considering that God often punishes them whom he loves and gives his enemies good success for a time whom afterward he will destroy.
sepulchres of the kings of Israel: They did not bury him in the city of David, where the sepulchres of the kings were.
